channel.title: Kinsu Health: guides
channel.description: Plain guides to keeping medical records, taking medicines on time and caring for family, for Indian families.

item.title: Caring for ageing parents’ health, even from another city
item.description: How to stay on top of your parents’ doctors, medicines and reports when you live far away: a practical plan that works without a hospital visit.

item.title: Discharge summary: why it’s the most important paper you’ll get
item.description: What a discharge summary is, what it should contain, how to check it before you leave the hospital, and how to keep it safe for the next doctor.

item.title: How to organise your family’s medical records: a simple system that lasts
item.description: A plain way to sort prescriptions, lab reports, scans and discharge summaries for the whole family, on paper and on your phone, so you can find them in a minute.

item.title: Is your health app safe? Seven questions to ask
item.description: Before you put your medicines, readings and reports into an app, ask these seven questions. We answer each one for Kinsu, too.

item.title: Keep copies before you send originals: insurance claims and your records
item.description: Insurers, employers and offices ask for original papers. Copy every page first, note what you sent, and you will never be left with nothing.

item.title: Lost a prescription? What to do next
item.description: A calm checklist for when a prescription goes missing: who to call, what to ask for, and how to make sure it never happens again.

item.title: The hospital file: what belongs in it, and how to stop losing pages
item.description: Admission, bills, reports, discharge summary: what to collect during a hospital stay, how to keep it together, and what to copy before you send the originals.

item.title: What to take to a doctor’s appointment: a checklist you can print
item.description: The papers, readings and questions that make a short appointment count, with a free printable checklist for your next visit.
